name: Proto-Blob (Fresh Out of the Box)
description: Default unpainted primer-grey rookie Blobster wearing its crooked cardboard shipping-box helmet with blue painter's tape, a slapped-on red-and-white HELLO name-tag sticker, a dangling factory barcode hang-tag, and a yellow rookie caution paddle—ready for Blobster Sculptor to paint.
